items.title: NMRoads Public User Guide
items.description: Explains how to use NMDOT's traveler map for road conditions, closures, construction, cameras, message signs, traffic, rest areas, weather, saved views, road-issue reporting, and hands-free alerts.
items.provenance_status: official public NMRoads PDF and byte-identical downloaded file recorded
processing_notes: Original authoritative 15-page PDF preserved without modification.
The guide states Last Revision: September-2024 and identifies NMRoads as New Mexico's official road advisory system.
Exact size and SHA-256 recorded; complete text extraction reviewed.
